# Reader fixtures

- `jbig2-symbol-offset.pdf`: tiny synthetic JBIG2 regression from Mozilla PDF.js (`test/pdfs/jbig2_symbol_offset.pdf`), Git blob `e653b42a7916d6c1024da3b0f8cb312db67e3174`. Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/blob/master/test/pdfs/jbig2_symbol_offset.pdf. The upstream Apache-2.0 license is retained in `PDFJS-LICENSE.txt`. This is a decoder test pattern, not a personal book.

- `alice.epub`: Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland, from the EPUB.js upstream regression corpus: https://github.com/futurepress/epub.js/blob/master/test/fixtures/alice.epub. Git blob `9ac6ba324a426914cb5839f9fe1e709b70add60b`. Original literary text by Lewis Carroll is public domain; retain the book’s own attribution and source notices.
- `tracemonkey.pdf`: Trace-based Just-in-Time Type Specialization for Dynamic Languages, from Mozilla PDF.js’s upstream regression corpus: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/blob/master/test/pdfs/tracemonkey.pdf. The paper retains its authors’ copyright and printed permissions; included solely as a reader interoperability test document, not as app content.
- The DOCX integration fixture is generated by the test and contains original test text.

Fixtures are not imported into the user's library automatically and are not included in the production build.
